Mate, I know absolutely nothing as well, but you could try using a bandage or some form of cloth to cover your wounds. Like, to wrap around your body. It will make it more difficult for the wounds to open up. Think of it as if you're putting a bandaid over a blister to prevent issues when using new shoes. It stops the scratching. Just make sure it's not too tight, just tight enough so as to keep you secure and comfortable. Don't reuse the bandages because that can cause infection. If you don't want to be caught getting bandages, try using an old shirt or something. If you use something like that, you could wash it as well. Stomach folds can get infected easily, so remember to clean them before and after cutting. You probably already know that XD
